svg.title: Which defences held in the Booz Allen OT exercise
svg.desc: Two groups. Four defences gave way: documentation obscurity, network segmentation, protocol complexity and the software command path. Two held: a controller that rejected a stop command, and a motor in local mode that could not be started remotely. Both of the latter are state held in hardware.
svg.text: Eight objectives cleared. Two safeguards reported as holding.
Gave way — all reachable from the network
Documentation obscurity — mapped the plant from subnet boundaries alone
Network segmentation — shaped and delayed the pivot, did not stop it
Protocol complexity — no OT guidance supplied, none needed
Software command path — gateways, policy, tool definitions
Held — state the network could not change
Controller refused a stop command — logic on the device itself
Motor in local mode — could not be started remotely at all
